description: This file defines the configuration state and parsing logic for voice talk mode gateway settings, including provider selection, voice aliases, models, and timeouts.

classes.name: TalkModeGatewayConfigState
classes.description: Immutable struct holding the current configuration state for voice talk mode, including provider, payload, voice IDs, model IDs, output format, API key, and timeout.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Static method that parses a dictionary configuration for voice talk mode, applies defaults, processes aliases, and returns a configured TalkModeGatewayConfigState instance.
